2021-22 SECOND SEMESTER, EXAMINATION
Dictation Syllabus
P.1 ____                     Name: ____________________  No.: _____
A. Sentences 80%
1. How many mangoes are there?
2. There are seventeen mangoes.
3. He is reading under the tree.
4. She is sleeping.
5. What colour is the T-shirt?
6. It is brown.
7. I can smell some flowers.
8. I can hear a dog.
9. I can touch a cat.
10. Their shoes are white.
11. Can a parrot fly?
12. No, they cannot.
13. My pet has pink eyes.
B. Vocabulary 20%
eat
drink
laugh
draw
sing
a skirt
trousers
a dress
a cap
socks
